patch.value: GH-828: init status registries must expose one coherent alias contract
Fresh trackers embed status aliases in settings.json and write schema/statuses.json, but the two generated registries disagree specifically on the in_progress alias.

Fresh init emits faithful alias data or an explicitly uniform summary; regeneration remains deterministic; fixtures cover in_progress and canceled aliases across both files; documentation states the authoritative registry
Make generated status registry projections visibly coherent and non-authoritative caches explicit
Reviewers and agents do not infer drift or hand-edit audited settings from contradictory generated data
Eliminates systematic fresh-tracker schema review noise
